Definition: probably of Hebrew origin (compare H4999); Nain, a place in Palestine:--Nain.
BiblicalUsage: Nain is a city in Galilee, and it is known for one morning when death was turned back at its gate. In Luke 7:11 Jesus goes into a city called Nain, with many of His disciples and much people, and at the gate He meets a widow carrying out her only son.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Nain is remembered because Jesus stopped a funeral there, and the whole town watched Him do it. A city no one would have named is named forever for what happened at its gate.
RelatedEvents: The Raising of the Widow's Son at Nain
